dreams.title: Full test metrics on MIST PubChem retrieval benchmark
dreams.protocol: MIST CANOPUS PubChem candidate retrieval; candidate positives share true molecule InChIKey first14 characters, negatives share molecular formula; rank cosine similarity of predicted and candidate fingerprints; accuracy@k is fraction of spectra with positive candidate in top k, printed as percent.
dreams.dataset: MIST CANOPUS benchmark, official MIST codebase for fingerprints and PubChem candidates
dreams.split: Full test set named in Extended Data Table 1; exact split version/hash unextracted
dreams.adaptation: DreaMS fingerprint uses supervised fine-tuning with cosine-similarity objective. Contrastive methods train with additional formula-matched PubChem candidates.
dreams.input_information: DreaMS uses raw spectra; MIST uses peak formula annotations. Do not portray as matched-input or zero-shot comparison.
dreams.denominators: Unreported in the inspected table/methods; 8000 spectra/7000 molecules describes total benchmark, not confirmed test denominator.
dreams.review_status: automated_source_checked_transcription; unpublished extraction; not independently reproduced
publication_gaps: Resolve comparator original-result identities before adding independent evidence counts.
Pin MIST dataset/split and distinguish fingerprint versus contrastive training information.
Create separate evaluated configurations, protocol and dataset; DreaMS fingerprint should be linked to family with fitting explicit.
